# std.markdown

<!-- Generated by `lang doc std` from the checked interfaces (lang 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

footnotes) rendered as HTML (the `lang_formats` native module).

## Functions

### `html`

```lang
fn html(text: String) -> String
```

The HTML for trusted Markdown (raw HTML in it passes through).

### `safe_html`

```lang
fn safe_html(text: String) -> String
```

The HTML for untrusted Markdown: raw HTML is escaped, and links and
images with a script or data URL lose it.
